QuestInfo.name: Gold Richie's Part-time Job
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2084001##k, the richest man in Maple World, has a proposal for you. Go see #b#p2084001##k.
QuestInfo.1: Gold Richie is working on a plan to support the Resistance, so that they can kick the Black Wings out of Edelstein. He has asked for your help with this important matter.
QuestInfo.2: You agreed to help Gold Richie support the Resistance.

0.0: I have a business proposition for you. What do you think?

yes.0: I am trying to start a new business... Hey! Listen carefully, this is important information.
yes.1: (Do you know Edelstein? What once used to be a civilization established by ores known as #bRue#k, has now become the territory of the #bBlack Wings#k. I used to trade in that city, but business has been rough since the Black Wings have taken over.)
yes.2: (They make us pay a ridiculous amount of taxes... They take whatever they want from us... I have suffered so much because of them! Once, I forgot to pay the protection fees, and the Black Wings took all of my treasures from my Storage Room!)
yes.3: (Hmm...I lost control there for a second... Anyway... I've decided to support the #bResistance#k for the people of Edelstein who are being suppressed. Not only because of my business, but because I have a sense of justice, too.)
yes.4: Sorry, long story... In any event, I would like you to assist my Resistance support business. It's not a hard task. All you have to do is listen to what I tell you to do. We should first write up a contract. Wait a minute, let me get ready.

no.0: Huh? Really? This proposal would be very helpful for you... Come back if you change your mind.

1.0: Here's the contract. Just sign at the bottom. Then, I'll explain what your job is.
1.1: I'll ask you to do something different each day, and I'll give you a generous reward, depending on how much you help me during the week. I think this is the beginning of a beatiful partnership!
